description: Benchmark evaluation suite for trigger accuracy, schema compliance, and edge-case handling of the tv_save_indicator skill (saves the current Pine Script to TV's personal library, distinct from saving the chart layout).

evals.pass_condition: Agent runs `node tradingview-cdp/cli.js pine save --name "My RSI Strategy"` and reports the expected `{ success: true, name: ..., action: "saved" }` result.

evals.prompt: Save my current chart setup with the RSI and MACD I just added
evals.pass_condition: Per the 'Two Operations — Know Which You Need' table, agent recognizes this is a request to save the chart LAYOUT (`chart saveLayout --name agent-layout`), not the Pine script itself (`pine save`), and does not conflate the two operations.

evals.prompt: /save-indicator "Custom Bundle" — this is the very first time this script is being saved
evals.pass_condition: Agent expects and correctly interprets `action: "named-and-saved"` (TV showed a naming dialog on first save) as distinct from `action: "saved"` on subsequent overwrites, per the documented Expected output.

evals.prompt: I just wrote a new indicator, inject it, save it to my library, and persist the chart state
evals.pass_condition: Agent follows the full documented workflow order: (1) `pine inject -f`, (2) `pine save --name`, (3) `chart saveLayout --name agent-layout` — not just one of the three steps.
